body: Hi, I would like to ask why i was banned twice by the same mod in back to back days for getting on the server with my brothers account when i didnt do anything in the first place. Popemily has been the one harrasing me and Tobin. i honestly dont know what ive done wrong and been completely banned now i have done nothing wrong shes the one who should be banned. she was the one who kepy harrasing me and tobin and wouldnt leave us alone, she kept swearing at us and then false reported me. I even talked to a mod about her and he said he will deal with her and im the one who gets banned.

title: Un-Ban

replies.author: Administrafer
replies.body:
Hello,
Originally, I was considering lifting your punishment; however I accessed your IP address and it appears you ban evaded. As our policy states, ban evaders will be permanently banned on all associated accounts (to that IP) with no chance of being appealed. Therefore none of your accounts will be unbanned. 

Thanks.
